title: cupania mutabilis var. coriacea
intro: Cupania mutabilis var. coriacea, commonly known as the West Indian Cupania or Panama Tree, is a plant species native to Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its ability to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Cupania mutabilis var. coriacea include reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
